### `reply.redirect()` has a new signature

The `reply.redirect()` method has a new signature:
`reply.redirect(url: string, code?: number)`.

```js
// v4
reply.redirect(301, '/new-route')
```

Change it to:

```js
// v5
reply.redirect('/new-route', 301)
```

This was already deprecated in v4 as `FSTDEP021`, so you should have already
updated your code to use the new signature.

### Changes to the .listen() method

The variadic argument signature of the `.listen()` method has been removed.
This means that you can no longer call `.listen()` with a variable number of arguments.

```js
// v4
fastify.listen(8000)
```

Will become:

```js
// v5
fastify.listen({ port: 8000 })
```

This was already deprecated in v4 as `FSTDEP011`, so you should have already updated
your code to use the new signature.

request.instructions: The documents are sections of the documentation of ONE open-source project at one commit. Report a conflict only when two sections make incompatible statements about the SAME option, flag, default value, limit, version requirement, or behavior, for the same product version and scope. These are NOT conflicts: values of different options; example values in code samples that merely override a default; statements explicitly scoped to an older version or to migration history; one section giving more detail than the other; different defaults that the text ties to different contexts (per-route vs global, dev vs build, agent mode vs server mode).
